summary.text: Rita Mayfield is a Democratic member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 60, in office since 2010, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the Appropriations-Public Safety Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rita Mayfield earned a B.S. in computer information systems from Columbia College and an M.S. in management and organization behavior from Benedictine University.
Mayfield assumed office in the Illinois House on July 6, 2010, and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her as chair of the Appropriations-Public Safety Committee and a member of the Consumer Protection, Cybersecurity, Data Analytics, and IT, House Financial Institutions, House Insurance, Public Utilities, and Revenue & Finance committees.
